video_title: “We Stayed Consistent And Kept Our Head Down To Get The W.” | Ayo Dosunmu Postgame Sound | 11.25.26

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on the Timberwolves' playoff aspirations and team mindset
quotes.excerpt: We want to win, we want to advance, we want to have a chance to win that big money.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: What did this mean for the group playing on Friday?

text_blocks.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
text_blocks.text: I feel great. That's what it's all about. I believe we have Minnesota, you probably know, never clinched, so that's a coach a game for sure. We want to win, we want to advance, we want to have a chance to win that big money. So it gives more incentive to go out there and compete.

quotes.social_post: Ayo Dosunmu on the Timberwolves' mindset as they chase a playoff spot: We want to win, we want to advance, we want to have a chance to win that big money. It gives more incentive to go out there and compete.

structured.context: Ayo Dosunmu discusses the team's motivation and mindset regarding their playoff aspirations.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on maintaining consistency through ups and downs
quotes.excerpt: Stay in the course, not getting too high, not getting too low.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: How did you guys kind of grind through this one? A lot of ups and downs.

text_blocks.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
text_blocks.text: Stay in the course, not getting too high, not getting too low. We started off a little slow, missed some shots that we normally make, but it's all about just staying consistent. Just wearing them down for 48 minutes, believing in the offense, believing in our schemes, staying together, and we were able to do that. We got some huge stops, got some huge rebounds, made some huge plays.

quotes.social_post: Ayo Dosunmu on the Timberwolves' grind: We started off a little slow, missed some shots that we normally make, but it is all about just staying consistent. Just wearing them down for 48 minutes.

structured.context: Ayo Dosunmu explains how the team maintained consistency to overcome a slow start during the game.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on Jaden McDaniels' growth and effectiveness in his role
quotes.excerpt: Jaden is getting the ball at what he's very effective at. He's one of the best mid-range scorers.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: What have you seen from Jaden growing into that role?

text_blocks.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
text_blocks.text: It's tough, especially when you got Melo in the action. Jaden is getting the ball at what he's very effective at. He's one of the best mid-range scorers and he's one of the most effective players in that mid-range area. So he's getting the ball right there, he's quick, he's making decisive decisions, and when he gets to his shot, it's very hard to contest because with his height and his touch and his confidence is growing.

quotes.social_post: Ayo Dosunmu on Jaden McDaniels: He is one of the best mid-range scorers and he is one of the most effective players in that mid-range area. When he gets to his shot, it is very hard to contest because with his height and his touch.

structured.context: Ayo Dosunmu evaluates the offensive growth and mid-range scoring effectiveness of teammate Jaden McDaniels.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on the demeanor and impact of Jaden McDaniels
quotes.excerpt: He definitely turned the corner into a premier star in this league.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: It seems like everyone just loves him. What is it about him?

text_blocks.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
text_blocks.text: His demeanor, his willingness for one to get better. He's a great teammate. Ever since I got here, he's been nothing but a great teammate. He uplifts others, and even when he doesn't have it going or if he's not getting shots, he's the same person, whether when he's got 30 or not. He's definitely turned the corner into a premier star in this league, and you see the work that he's put in.

quotes.social_post: Ayo Dosunmu on Jaden McDaniels: He has definitely turned the corner into a premier star in this league, and you see the work that he has put in.

structured.context: Ayo Dosunmu praises the work ethic and demeanor of teammate Jaden McDaniels.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on LaMelo Ball's injury and team support
quotes.excerpt: Just praying for him, just praying for him, hoping nothing is too serious.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: See LaMelo go down, what's going through your mind?

text_blocks.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
text_blocks.text: Just praying for him, just praying for him, hoping nothing is too serious. Hoping he's able to shake back like I know he would. I know he wants to be out there and compete, and anytime someone goes down, I'm always praying for them because I understand what it takes to go out there and play and what you have to put your body through each night in, night out.

quotes.social_post: Ayo Dosunmu on seeing LaMelo Ball go down with an injury: Just praying for him, just praying for him, hoping nothing is too serious. Hoping he is able to shake back like I know he would.

structured.context: Ayo Dosunmu reacts to LaMelo Ball suffering an injury during the game.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on his offensive rhythm and mindset after missed shots
quotes.excerpt: If I know I missed a shot that I normally make, I count it as a make.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: How do you stay in it enough so that you are in position to make big shots?

text_blocks.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
text_blocks.text: If I know I missed a shot that I normally make, I count it as a make. I don't let makes and misses determine how my game is. I try to pick up on defense, make extra plays on defense, do the little things that's probably necessarily not scoring, and that helps me get in a rhythm. Always keep going, trusting in my work, trusting in my ability, never lose the confidence.

quotes.social_post: Ayo Dosunmu on his shooting mindset: If I know I missed a shot that I normally make, I count it as a make. I do not let makes and misses determine how my game is.

structured.context: Ayo Dosunmu describes his mental approach to staying confident and impactful after missing shots.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on the rivalry and championship pedigree of the Oklahoma City Thunder
quotes.excerpt: Knowing that they have the championship pedigree, it's always good to go up against that.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: Can you feel a little difference with that rivalry as it's developed with OKC?

text_blocks.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
text_blocks.text: Sure, and I'm here to inherit it. I'm here to push it. I understand the importance of just playing against them. Knowing that they have the championship pedigree, it's always good to go up against that. They have the next guy up mentality, so anytime you play against them, as long as they have the MVP over there, they have a chance to win.

quotes.social_post: Ayo Dosunmu on the rivalry with OKC: I understand the importance of just playing against them. Knowing that they have the championship pedigree, it is always good to go up against that.

structured.context: Ayo Dosunmu shares his perspective on the rivalry with the Oklahoma City Thunder and their championship pedigree.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on the Timberwolves' next-man-up culture and depth
quotes.excerpt: That's our culture, that's our mindset, just next man up, just being ready to play.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: It feels like you guys have that mentality too, right?

text_blocks.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
text_blocks.text: That's our culture, that's our mindset, just next man up, just being ready to play, being ready to contribute. Each and every guy works extremely hard to go out there and compete and try to help us win. We're so deep that at full strength, some guys that are playing huge minutes that was not in the rotation, and that just showcased how deep we are.

quotes.social_post: Ayo Dosunmu on the Timberwolves' depth: That is our culture, that is our mindset, just next man up, just being ready to play, being ready to contribute.

structured.context: Ayo Dosunmu highlights the depth and next-man-up culture of the Timberwolves roster.
